summary: Beijing Nanyuan Airport, located in Fengtai District in southern Beijing, was China's oldest airport with origins dating back to the early 20th century. It historically served as Beijing's primary aviation gateway before being eclipsed by the much larger Beijing Capital International Airport and later Daxing. Commercial operations at Nanyuan ceased in September 2019 when flights were transferred to the newly opened Beijing Daxing International Airport.
